name: @pcbjs/renderer
description: CPU renderer that turns a glTF binary into an RGBA image

scripts.build:wasm: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && cargo build --locked --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir build/pkg --out-name renderer build/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/pcbjs_renderer.wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:check && npm run build:rollup
scripts.lint:core: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
scripts.release:check: npm run format:check && npm run lint:core && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:core && npm run spec:check && npm run pack-smoke

author: Yuxuan Zhang

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: npx lint-staged && "$HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo" fmt --all && git add -u -- src/core
